title: Ex16 - Code: Stacked bar chart iris
text: Using the iris dataset (dfIris), plot a stacked histogram of sepal.width with variety as hue using sns.histplot() with multiple='stack'.
answer:
sns.histplot(data=dfIris, x='sepal.width', hue='variety', multiple='stack')
plt.title('Sepal.width distribution')
plt.xlabel('sepal.width')
plt.ylabel('Value')
